spell.readOnly: This book is read-only: the selection and the word list cannot be changed.
spell.defaultUsed: No dictionary chosen yet: using the default for the book language ({name}). Turn a dictionary on or off below to choose your own.
spell.defaultNone: No bundled dictionary matches the book language ({language}). Import one, or turn one on below.
spell.missing: The dictionary "{name}" ({scope}) is not installed on this computer. It stays selected in the book; spellcheck skips it until it is installed.
spell.shadowed: Hidden by a local dictionary with the same name
spell.deleteLine: Its files are removed from disk. Books that use it will skip it until it is imported again.
spell.imported: Imported "{name}". Turn it on in the list to use it in this book.

errors.invalid-name: The name is empty, too long, starts with a dot or contains characters that are not allowed in a file name.
errors.bad-dic: The .dic file is not a Hunspell dictionary: its first line must be the number of words.
errors.bad-aff: The .aff file is not a valid Hunspell affix file.
errors.unsupported-encoding: Only UTF-8 dictionaries are supported. Convert the files to UTF-8 and try again.
errors.empty-wordlist: The word list has no words.
errors.exists: A dictionary with this name already exists in that place.
errors.read-only: This cannot be changed: the book or the dictionary is read-only.
errors.no-local: Open a book first to use local dictionaries.
errors.same-scope: The dictionary is already in that place.

import.title: Import a dictionary
import.list: Word list file (one word per line)
import.name: Name

scopeHint.local: Stored inside this book's folder and travels with it.
scopeHint.global: Stored on this computer and available in every book.

custom.title: Words added to this book
custom.hint: Names and invented terms you added with "Add to dictionary". Stored with the book.
custom.empty: No words yet. Right-click an underlined word in the editor and choose "Add to dictionary".

shortcuts.rebindHint: App shortcuts can be changed in Settings. Editor keys are fixed.

actions.panelToggle: Show or hide the side panel

settings.title: Keyboard shortcuts
settings.hint: Choose an action, then press the new keys. Esc cancels. Editor keys are fixed.

error.needsModifier: Use Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) together with another key.
error.reserved: {combo} is reserved by the system or the browser.

manuscript.title: Write your manuscript
manuscript.body: Chapters and scenes live in the tree under Write. Drag to reorder, and keep notes in the inbox.

timelines.title: Timelines and linking
timelines.body: Place events on one or more timelines, then link scenes to events so the story keeps its order.

rules.title: Rules of your world
rules.body: Write down what must stay true, such as how magic works, and link the rules to the scenes they affect.

codex.title: The codex
codex.body: Characters, places and things, with relationships and what each of them knows and when.

checks.title: Checks
checks.body: Storyworks looks for slips in dates, states and knowledge. The badge counts open findings.

help.title: Help
help.logOnlyInApp: The log folder can only be opened in the desktop app.
help.logFailed: Could not open the log folder.

rawRestore.offer: There is an automatic backup of this book. Restoring it brings back its files; the current ones are copied aside first and nothing is deleted.
rawRestore.no-backup: This book has no automatic backup. Nothing was changed.
rawRestore.backup-invalid: The latest backup cannot be used either. Nothing was changed.

crash.title: The app closed unexpectedly
crash.body: Storyworks did not close properly last time. Your work is saved as of the last automatic save.
crash.damagedBody: All files match the expected format. | One file does not match the expected format. | {n} files do not match the expected format.
crash.backupOffer: Restore the latest automatic backup from {when}? Your current files are copied aside first.
crash.noBackup: There is no automatic backup for this book.
crash.verifyFailed: Could not check the book files.
